# XDA

> XDA is a comprehensive tech resource covering computing news, hardware reviews, software guides, and deals across Windows, Linux, macOS, and emerging technologies.

XDA Developers provides in-depth coverage of operating systems, hardware components, productivity tools, and DIY projects for tech enthusiasts. The site specializes in optimization guides, self-hosting solutions, and expert reviews of devices ranging from laptops to gaming handhelds.

## Key Topics

- Windows 11
- Linux distributions
- Self-hosting
- Home lab
- Hardware reviews
- AI tools
- Gaming handhelds
- Laptops
- Docker
- Proxmox
- Open-source
- Smart home
- Budget builds
- Product deals
- 3D printing

## Core Operating Systems

- [Windows | XDA](https://www.xda-developers.com/windows): Windows hub: Windows 11 news, optimization, debloating, tutorials
- [Linux | XDA](https://www.xda-developers.com/linux-hub): Linux hub: Distros, Proxmox, gaming, self-hosting, Wayland/X11
- [macOS | XDA](https://www.xda-developers.com/macos): macOS coverage: utilities, optimization, apps, gaming, window management

## Devices & Hardware

- [Laptops | XDA](https://www.xda-developers.com/laptops): Laptop hub: reviews, buyer's guide, MacBook, Windows laptops, comparisons
- [Gaming Handhelds | XDA](https://www.xda-developers.com/gaming-handhelds): Gaming handhelds: Steam Deck, ROG Ally X, Nintendo Switch 2 reviews
- [Devices | XDA](https://www.xda-developers.com/devices): Devices hub: phones, smartwatches, streaming devices, smart home
- [CPU | XDA](https://www.xda-developers.com/processor): CPU reference hub: Intel Core Ultra, Arrow Lake, benchmarks, thermal management
- [What is a GPU? Inside the component that powers gaming and more](https://www.xda-developers.com/gpu): GPU guide explaining graphics cards, history, manufacturers, gaming hardware

## Hardware & Peripherals Reference

- [Monitors | XDA](https://www.xda-developers.com/monitors): Monitor buying guide: OLED, QD-OLED, 4K displays, gaming monitors
- [Storage | XDA](https://www.xda-developers.com/storage): Storage reference: SSDs, RAID, backup tools, rsync, disk management
- [Keyboards & Mice | XDA](https://www.xda-developers.com/input-devices): Input devices hub: Logitech, Corsair, mechanical keyboards, peripherals
- [Prebuilt PCs | XDA](https://www.xda-developers.com/prebuilt-pc): Prebuilt PC hub: mini-PC deals, budget builds, Mac Mini, gaming PCs

## Self-Hosting & DIY Projects

- [Self-Hosting | XDA](https://www.xda-developers.com/self-hosting): Self-hosting guide: Docker, home servers, AI hosting, cloud alternatives
- [Home Lab | XDA](https://www.xda-developers.com/home-lab): Home lab hub: DIY projects, 3D printing, server setup, budget builds
- [Single-Board Computers | XDA](https://www.xda-developers.com/single-board-computers): SBC guide: Raspberry Pi, DIY projects, maker projects, hardware setup

## Software & Productivity

- [Software and Services | XDA](https://www.xda-developers.com/software-and-services): Software coverage: Adobe, Windows, ChatGPT, open-source, subscriptions
- [Productivity & Creativity Tools | XDA](https://www.xda-developers.com/productivity): Productivity tools: Microsoft Loop, Excel, automation, note-taking apps

## News & Deals

- [News | XDA](https://www.xda-developers.com/news): Latest tech news covering Windows, AI, ChatGPT, hardware and software
- [Best Tech Deals Today — Curated by XDA](https://www.xda-developers.com/deals): Expert-curated daily tech deals on gadgets, smart home, electronics
